Home.tagline: Tap or scan the card on your table to open the menu.

StaffSignIn.heading: Sign in to Maasii
StaffSignIn.intro: For owners and managers. Use the email or phone you were invited with.

StaffInvitation.title: Your invitation
StaffInvitation.heading: Invitation
StaffInvitation.ownerIntro: {name}, you are invited to be an Owner of {place}. You will sign in with <contact>{address}</contact> and the password you choose here.
StaffInvitation.managerIntro: {name}, you are invited to be a Manager at {place}. You will sign in with <contact>{address}</contact> and the password you choose here.
StaffInvitation.passwordHelp: At least 8 characters. If you already have a Maasii account, enter its password.

StaffAdmin.noOwner: No owner yet. Invite one below.

StaffManage.noAccess: You don't manage any venue yet. Ask your brand's owner for an invitation.

StaffManage.venueQrAlt: QR code for the {name} Venue Link

StaffErrors.invalid_input: Check the fields and try again.
StaffErrors.not_allowed: You don't have permission to do this.
StaffErrors.not_found: We couldn't find what you were looking for.
StaffErrors.badCredentials: That email, phone or password is not right.

StaffErrors.tableNumberTaken: A table with that number already exists at this venue.
StaffErrors.invitationNotFound: This invitation link is not valid. Ask for a new one.
